bio: Note: The restaurant is temporarily serving a seasonal pop-up concept, Playa Oxomoco, focused on seafood-forward dishes. Don’t let the casual ambience fool you: Oxomoco is a serious dining room capable of great things in its wood-fired oven. The room is lively and packed but always conducive to conversation.Tacos are the main draw, especially when piled with the likes of tender flank steak or soft-shell crab. However, this kitchen team doesn’t stick to merely one dish or area of Mexico. Instead, they reach widely across a myriad of regions, always balancing abundance with fresh and vibrant flavors.
